Title: LinkedIn Learning and Degreed Deep Integration Guide

Blocks.Text: The following steps outline the Degreed and LinkedIn Learning integration process:
Authentication: SAML Identity Provider
Content Discovery: Automated Catalog Sync (All languages)
Reporting: xAPI
Requirements:
The LinkedIn Learning and Degreed integration involves the following requirements:

An active Degreed LMS instance

An active LinkedIn Learning account

Admin access to LinkedIn Learning

Admin privileges to your Degreed LMS instance
Check out our overview of Degreed's integration benefits and capabilities.

During the initial configuration, you can configure LinkedIn Learning and
Degreed to establish a secure SAML single sign-on (SSO) connection to ensure seamless access to
content. SSO authentication reduces friction for users and administrators by eliminating the
need for manual user registration. SSO ensures learners spend more of their time watching content and less of their time trying to remember usernames and passwords.

The LinkedIn Learning library contains thousands of courses. Courses are added
at a rate of 25-30 courses per week at no extra cost. Traditionally, the
administrator of a content discovery platform manually uploads new content on a
regular interval. However, the Degreed deep integration uses LinkedIn Learning
APIs to dynamically refresh the content library daily. This ensures new LinkedIn
Learning content is available within 24 hours of its release.

All content titles and descriptions are aggregated and indexed to accommodate
keyword searches and enhance discoverability. Degreed supports automatic syncing of All languages content libraries.

SAML SSO is recommended for all enterprise learning platform integrations. You
can configure SSO authentication in your LinkedIn Learning Admin settings. Most
organizations have a centrally-managed identity management solution like Azure
AD, Okta, or ADFS that you can configure to authenticate users into enterprise
applications like LinkedIn Learning.
To configure SAML SSO with your identity management solution, share our LinkedIn Learning SSO Implementation Guide with your organization's IT team.
Important
For xAPI to work, the Bridge unique identifier (i.e., email address) must match the LinkedIn Learning SSO identifier.

Blocks.Section: Provision API Keys for Content Catalog Sync
SectionPath: Provision API Keys for Content Catalog Sync
Blocks.Text: For Degreed to sync LinkedIn Learning catalog metadata, API keys must be provisioned in LinkedIn Learning admin settings. To implement content sync in LinkedIn Learning, take the following steps:

Blocks.Section: Provision API Keys for Content Catalog Sync
SectionPath: Provision API Keys for Content Catalog Sync
Blocks.Text:
After you log in, if you are not already in the Admin screen, select Go to Admin.



From the side navigation menu, select Access content and reports via API, then expand Generate LinkedIn Learning REST API Application.

Click Add application.

In the Add LinkedIn Learning API application screen, enter "Degreed" in the Application Name field.

In the Application description field, provide a short description of the integration use case. For example, "Degreed content catalog sync".

Under Choose keys, there are two checkboxes – Content and Report. Select Content.  

Click Next and accept the "Terms and Conditions".


Save the Client ID and Client Secret values for use in the step.

Paste the Client ID and Client Secret into the corresponding Degreed fields.

SectionPath: Enable xAPI Learner Activity Tracking in LinkedIn Learning
Blocks.Text: Note

Blocks.Section: Enable xAPI Learner Activity Tracking in LinkedIn Learning
SectionPath: Enable xAPI Learner Activity Tracking in LinkedIn Learning
Blocks.Text: To get the required data from Degreed, contact your Degreed Technical Implementation Consultant or email support@degreed.com.

Blocks.Section: Enable xAPI Learner Activity Tracking in LinkedIn Learning
SectionPath: Enable xAPI Learner Activity Tracking in LinkedIn Learning
Blocks.Text: Using the information you acquired in the previous step, follow the instructions below to configure LinkedIn Learning:

Blocks.Section: Enable xAPI Learner Activity Tracking in LinkedIn Learning
SectionPath: Enable xAPI Learner Activity Tracking in LinkedIn Learning
Blocks.Text:
After you log in, if you are not already in the Admin screen, select Go to Admin.



From the side navigation menu, select LMS Configure reporting APIs.

Expand the Configure xAPI panel.

Click Add integration.

In the Add xAPI integration screen, enter "Degreed reporting" Integration name field.

In the User Type field, select "ID".

Copy and paste the Client Secret, Client ID, Tenant Server URL, and OAuth Server URL provided by Degreed into LinkedIn Learning.

Click Enable.

Blocks.Section: Enable xAPI Learner Activity Tracking in LinkedIn Learning
SectionPath: Enable xAPI Learner Activity Tracking in LinkedIn Learning
Blocks.Text: You have enabled the Degreed xAPI keys in LinkedIn Learning.
To complete the configuration with Degreed, you will need the following information:

Client ID

Client Secret

LinkedIn Learning Languages Purchased

LinkedIn Learning Account ID
Once you’ve gathered the required information, follow the Degreed configuration instructions.

Blocks.Section: Degreed Video Curation & Reporting - Admin steps to enable settings
SectionPath: Degreed Video Curation & Reporting - Admin steps to enable settings
Blocks.Text: To utilise Video curation, please follow below steps. It is a two step process. Enabling settings in LinkedIn Learning and Degreed are mandatory to utilise Video curation and reporting.

Blocks.Section: Degreed Video Curation & Reporting - Admin steps to enable settings
SectionPath: Degreed Video Curation & Reporting - Admin steps to enable settings
Blocks.Text:
Turn on xAPI settings in LinkedIn Learning.


Please contact your Degreed Customer Success Manager (CSM) or the Support team to request that the settings be enabled, as they are turned off by default on Degreed's side.

Blocks.Section: Degreed Video Curation & Reporting - Admin steps to enable settings
SectionPath: Degreed Video Curation & Reporting - Admin steps to enable settings
Blocks.Text: Once the above two steps are enabled, end users can leverage Video level curation and they can see the completions with in Degreed platform.

Blocks.Section: Steps to curate videos and Reporting
SectionPath: Steps to curate videos and Reporting
Blocks.Text:
Share Videos from LinkedIn Learning to Degreed


Once shared, Videos will appear under Videos selection in Degreed.

Once the video completed successfully, the completed videos will appear on Degreed side --> Home --> Saved. A verified tick appears on the Video completion.


To report on Video completions, please reach out Degreed CSM or support team.
